_comment: Copy to .sugo-private.json and fill in. That file is gitignored and never leaves the machine. build.py loads it automatically from the skill root, the repo root, or ~/.sugo-private.json — first one found wins.
remittance: Payable by ACH or check. Bank details on file.

sugo._use: Default. Every client unless a profile below says otherwise.
sugo.legal_line: © {year} Sugo Product Company LLC d/b/a Sugo AI

contractor._use: Engagements where Marc is engaged personally as an independent contractor rather than through the LLC. Named per client in `clients` below — never assumed.

CLIENT_KEY.description: Scope line that appears on every invoice for this client.
